input:
We're seeing display glitches (green frames) during camera preview when GPU composition is active. The camera ISP writes to DMA-BUF buffers that are consumed by the GPU compositor, but under load the ISP seems to underrun and the GPU reads stale/partial data.

Logcat:
04-10 14:22:01.234 CameraHAL: ISP frame 4201 write complete, fence fd=42
04-10 14:22:01.236 SurfaceFlinger: acquired buffer slot 3, fence fd=42
04-10 14:22:01.237 SurfaceFlinger: GPU composition start, 4 layers
04-10 14:22:01.239 CameraHAL: WARNING: ISP DMA underrun on channel 2, bytes_remaining=32768
04-10 14:22:01.240 SurfaceFlinger: fence fd=42 signaled (GPU read started)
04-10 14:22:01.241 MALI: Job completed with INSTR_INVALID_PC
04-10 14:22:01.242 SurfaceFlinger: display frame 8844: composition error, fallback to client

dmesg:
[14222.301] isp-dma: ch2 underrun, FIFO empty at line 1920
[14222.302] isp-dma: recovery: reset ch2, restart from line 1920
[14222.305] mali 13000000.gpu: GPU fault 0x50 at 0x0000000280100000
[14222.306] mali 13000000.gpu: AS0 page fault reading at address 0x0000000280100000

Is the fence signaling too early, or is the ISP DMA genuinely underrunning?
